# Where to Watch These Stones


by Angel | October 15, 2026


In *These Stones* , biblical history meets modern life through an unusual supernatural program. Undercover biblical figures are matched with people struggling through difficult circumstances, offering wisdom and perspective drawn from their own experiences.


Blending biblical stories with contemporary struggles, *These Stones* is a moving series about faith, forgiveness, and the possibility of a fresh start.[Stream Season 1 now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/these-stones)


### **When Biblical History Meets Modern Life**


The Bible is filled with people who faced fear, failure, loss, doubt, and difficult choices. *These Stones* asks what their experiences might offer someone facing similar struggles today.


Through a supernatural program, biblical figures are placed undercover and matched with people navigating challenges in the modern world. Each pairing creates an opportunity for a familiar biblical story to take on new meaning as its themes connect with someone else’s life.


Rather than keeping biblical history in the distant past, the series brings its characters and their experiences into the present. Their stories become a lens through which modern struggles can be examined, opening the door to questions about faith, character, and the choices that shape a person’s future.


### **A Daughter Inherits More Than a Mission**


At the center of *These Stones* is a woman grieving the loss of her mother.


Her mother’s work with the supernatural program becomes an unexpected part of her own life, drawing her into a world she must learn to navigate while still trying to maintain the appearance of normalcy.


But she’s carrying more than grief. Her past mistakes weigh on her, and becoming involved in her mother’s mission forces her to reckon with the person she has been and the person she hopes to become.


This personal journey gives the series an emotional thread that connects its larger supernatural premise to a very human struggle. While biblical figures help others confront their challenges, the daughter must face questions of her own.


### **Why These Stories Resonate**


Although *These Stones* uses a supernatural premise, the emotions at its center are familiar.


Grief can leave people searching for direction. Regret can make it difficult to imagine a better future. And when someone is struggling, the right words or a new perspective can help them see their circumstances differently.


The series connects those experiences with biblical history, encouraging audiences to look beyond the surface of each character’s situation. Every pairing offers a chance to consider how faith and the lessons of Scripture might speak to the challenges people face today.


Viewers have responded to the series’ combination of strong performances, character development, and emotionally engaging storylines.


One reviewer wrote, “The acting was amazing! The story lines were captivating,” adding that the episodes were moving and inspirational because the characters and their struggles felt relatable.


Another called it “one of the best Bible-based TV shows” they had seen, praising its writing, acting, and character development.


For viewers who enjoy stories that combine contemporary drama with biblical themes, *These Stones* offers a distinctive way to explore familiar questions of faith and the human experience.


### **Watch** ***These Stones*** **on Angel**


*These Stones* brings biblical history into the present through stories of people facing difficult choices, painful circumstances, and the possibility of change. With compelling characters and themes of forgiveness, repentance, and faith, the series offers a fresh perspective on the timeless stories of Scripture.


[Stream Season 1 of These Stones now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/these-stones)
